\u27e6CODE1\u27e7: ["```python title=\"chatgpt_sign_in.py\"", "import uuid", "import webbrowser", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai.models.openai import OpenAIResponsesModel", "from pydantic_ai.providers.openai_chatgpt import OpenAIChatGPTOAuthFlow, OpenAIChatGPTProvider", "", "HOST_ID = uuid.uuid4().urn  # create once per installation and persist it", "", "", "async def main():", "    flow = OpenAIChatGPTOAuthFlow(app_name='My App', host_id=HOST_ID)", "    webbrowser.open(flow.authorization_url())", "    credentials = await flow.exchange_code_from_callback()", "", "    provider = OpenAIChatGPTProvider(credentials=credentials)", "    agent = Agent(OpenAIResponsesModel('gpt-6.1-sol', provider=provider))", "    result = await agent.run('Where does \"hello world\" come from?')", "    print(result.output)", "```"]
\u27e6CODE2\u27e7: ["```python title=\"chatgpt_persist.py\"", "import json", "import uuid", "import webbrowser", "from dataclasses import asdict", "from pathlib import Path", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai.models.openai import OpenAIResponsesModel", "from pydantic_ai.providers.openai_chatgpt import (", "    OpenAIChatGPTCredentials,", "    OpenAIChatGPTCredentialSource,", "    OpenAIChatGPTOAuthFlow,", "    OpenAIChatGPTProvider,", ")", "", "", "class FileCredentialSource(OpenAIChatGPTCredentialSource):", "    def __init__(self, path: Path):", "        self.path = path", "", "    async def load(self) -> OpenAIChatGPTCredentials:", "        return OpenAIChatGPTCredentials(**json.loads(self.path.read_text()))", "", "    async def save(self, credentials: OpenAIChatGPTCredentials) -> None:", "        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(asdict(credentials)))", "", "", "async def main():", "    host_id_file = Path('chatgpt-host-id')", "    if not host_id_file.exists():", "        host_id_file.write_text(uuid.uuid4().urn, encoding='utf-8')", "    source = FileCredentialSource(Path('chatgpt-credentials.json'))", "    if not source.path.exists():", "        flow = OpenAIChatGPTOAuthFlow(app_name='My App', host_id=host_id_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))", "        webbrowser.open(flow.authorization_url())", "        await source.save(await flow.exchange_code_from_callback())", "", "    provider = OpenAIChatGPTProvider(credential_source=source)", "    agent = Agent(OpenAIResponsesModel('gpt-6.1-sol', provider=provider))", "    result = await agent.run('Where does \"hello world\" come from?')", "    print(result.output)", "```"]
\u27e6CODE3\u27e7: ["```python title=\"chatgpt_sign_in_again.py\"", "import webbrowser", "", "from pydantic_ai.providers.openai_chatgpt import OpenAIChatGPTCredentials, OpenAIChatGPTOAuthFlow", "", "", "async def sign_in_again(saved: OpenAIChatGPTCredentials, host_id: str) -> OpenAIChatGPTCredentials:", "    flow = OpenAIChatGPTOAuthFlow(", "        app_name='My App', host_id=host_id, client_id=saved.client_id, id_token_hint=saved.id_token", "    )", "    # `prompt=consent` asks a user who declined plan usage again.", "    extra_params = None if saved.plan_usage_granted else {'prompt': 'consent'}", "    webbrowser.open(flow.authorization_url(extra_params=extra_params))", "    return await flow.exchange_code_from_callback()", "```"]
